description: LinkedIn job postings for a keyword and location from LinkedIn's public (logged-out) job search: job title, company, company page, location, posting date, 'actively hiring' flag, job ID and job URL, 10 per page. Job descriptions, salaries and applicant counts are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_xing when you need job listings from XING for a keyword and optional location; jobs_4dayweek when you need newest 4-day-week and flexible job postings. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

keywords.description: Job title or skills, e.g. data engineer (required)

location.description: City, region or country, e.g. Berlin (default: worldwide)

name: jobs_linkedin
title: LinkedIn job postings for a keyword and location
